definitions.candidate: Seed zero has a repeated peak pattern (four repeats, relative tolerance 2e-5) and class 2 or 3.
definitions.strict: Additionally all three starts are near-zero/nonpositive or stationary by the finite-time screen.
definitions.interval: Consecutive successful nodes; a one-node interval is retained, not silently removed.

limitations: Long transients can split or create candidate intervals.
A transect interval is not automatically a distinct globally connected layer.
Peak period is a diagnostic, not a proof of an attracting cycle.
